end.parentNote: Dev practised identifying circle parts and relating radius, diameter, and chord length. They explained that not all chords pass through the centre and correctly used the largest-chord idea to reject a 10 cm chord when the diameter was 8 cm; they also correctly found 14 cm as the diameter of a 7 cm radius circle. Dev initially mixed up sector and segment, then corrected this later in the lesson. At home, ask Dev to label a circle diagram with a sector and segment and explain the difference.
